Underactuation clarification aligns with these distinctions. No new correction accepted from preparation.

Chapter6 links input-image feasibility, path timing, event sensitivities, uncertainty and conditional optimization; noise and contact scope are consistent with prior chapters. Numerical success is separated from nonlinear certificate and biological identification. No new correction accepted from preparation.

Chapter7 distinguishes moving-boundary invariance, progress/event-output inclusion, forward outer enclosure and initial inner capture certificate; SOS equality multipliers, whole-time coverage and original-model remainder checks are consistent. Scalar SOS remainder after subtracting epsilon=r^2(1-r^2) equals that epsilon; original wording same positive constant is read as referring to the chosen epsilon, not a newly confirmed error.

Chapter8 retains actual phase rate, configuration-output Hessian, decoupling authority, velocity consistency, zero-dynamics and reset invariance; active virtual constraints are distinct from stationary ideal passive reactions. No new correction accepted from preparation.

Chapter9 carries discrete/continuous noise units and square-root time scaling, multiplicative covariance, event termination and Ito phase correction; deterministic positive phase drift is not sample-path monotonicity under phase diffusion. Task-specific primary experiments are separated from golf transfer. No new correction accepted from preparation.

Chapter10 distinguishes trial error convergence, command/noise transients, identifiability, policy optimization and verified capture sets. Common Lyapunov certificates are distinguished from arbitrary stable-controller interpolation. No new correction accepted from preparation.
